payload.scan_note: Phase S sector scan (run_config.output_scope=scan). These 3 funds represent the sector for cross-sector comparison, not a single theme's value chain — representativeness across replication styles was prioritized over holding-level purity.

candidates.name: State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF
candidates.notes: Cap-weighted, full-GICS-technology-sector fund (also carries a small energy sleeve per GICS reclassification, ~0.1% of weight); representative as the sector's broad passive benchmark. Cap-weighting concentrates the fund in a handful of mega-caps (NVDA/AAPL/MSFT), which is a known feature of this type rather than a defect.

structure_trading.real_cost_notes: Expense ratio 0.08% plus an average spread of <1bp (~0.01% of price) per ETF Research Center (2026-09-06) — among the cheapest all-in-cost sector funds in the market; TCO figure itself not disclosed on the free tier.

candidates.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
candidates.notes: The focused/sub-industry representative — concentrated purely in semiconductor manufacturing and equipment names (25 largest US-listed semis) rather than the whole IT sector; top holdings NVDA (~21.7%), TSM, AVGO, AMD, ASML.

structure_trading.real_cost_notes: Expense ratio 0.35% plus an average spread of <1bp (~0.01% of price) per ETF Research Center (2026-09-06); total cost of ownership reported there at 36bp vs a 50bp peer average.

candidates.name: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Technology ETF
candidates.index: S&P 500 Equal Weight Information Technology Index
candidates.notes: The structurally-different representative: same S&P 500 IT constituent universe as a cap-weighted fund but equal-weighted, which materially dilutes the mega-cap concentration seen in XLK and spreads exposure across mid/smaller names in the sector.

structure_trading.real_cost_notes: Expense ratio 0.40% plus an average spread of ~2bp (0.02% of price, range 2-4bp) per ETF Research Center (2026-09-06); TCO reported there at 42bp vs a 63bp peer average. Lower AUM/volume than XLK or SMH but still comfortably above the run's USD 100M / USD 5M-per-day structure-gate thresholds.
